capabilities: Attach a description note to a folder via Ctrl+Click
Open a folder's attached note by clicking the folder
Rename folder notes in sync with folder names
Create folders from the active note file
Generate card-style folder overviews with ccard code blocks
extras: The Auto Rename feature is described as experimental and 'does not always work'; ccard code block syntax is documented elsewhere. Known issues include the folder note briefly appearing when created.
motivation: The README says the goal is to 'Make your vault to be a hierarchy note system.'
problem: Obsidian's file explorer treats folders as containers only, with no way to attach a descriptive note that opens when you click a folder.
summary: Folder note plugin that attaches a description note to each folder and can generate card-style overviews of folder contents.
